_comment: PROFILE B (deferred activation). Drop-in replacement for branch-protection.json once a second CODEOWNER (or the @lttim/actuarial-reviewers team) exists. Differences vs. the active profile are CONFINED to required_pull_request_reviews -- everything else (status checks, linear history, force-push policy, conversation resolution) MUST stay byte-identical, and tests/test_branch_protection_drift.py asserts that drift. Apply when ready: gh api -X PUT repos/:owner/:repo/branches/main/protection --input .github/branch-protection.with-second-reviewer.json. See annuity_model/docs/CODEOWNERS_RATIONALE.md, section 'Second-CODEOWNER upgrade path', for the full activation checklist (CODEOWNERS uncomment + team creation + this profile swap, in that order).
